home.lede: Deathless Celeste clears by the Chinese-speaking community. Browse challenges, player achievements, and run videos.
home.scope: The Gist tracks difficult deathless Celeste challenges completed by the Chinese-speaking community. Browse the main list by difficulty and number of clears, explore map packs in All Maps, or visit a challenge or player page to see their runs.
home.scopeOther: The Gist also covers deathless segments, multi-map challenges across lobbies or chapters, and vanilla challenges.
home.tiers: Ranked challenges are graded by {term}. Lower numbers mean harder challenges; {subtiers} are each divided into High, Mid, and Low.
home.video1: Submissions should come from players in the Chinese-speaking community. Run videos must be publicly accessible on a host that keeps them available long term. Runs posted outside Bilibili, such as on YouTube or Twitch, are only added at the player’s request.
home.video2: The video must show the entire deathless run in a single continuous play session, including everything from picking up the golden berry to collecting it at the end.
home.video3: RAW footage (a complete, unedited recording) is optional at every {term}.
home.video4: Do not alter gameplay beyond what the map allows, abuse information mods to reveal information you would not otherwise have, or abuse pausing to make inputs easier, such as through pause buffering.
home.video5: Administrators also look for videos of ranked challenges and add them after review. Players are welcome to submit runs so they are not missed.
home.map1: Maps must be publicly available and have a deathless video by a CN community player. Ranked challenges must be harder than the vanilla 6B, 7B, and 8B golden strawberries and are graded by Tier. Challenges easier than Tier 7 are Standard and may also be submitted. Administrators do not review these runs; they are published as unverified personal records.
home.map2: New challenges are marked Undetermined until their difficulty is agreed on. They then appear in the main list.
home.map3: Different versions of a map are accepted unless otherwise specified.
home.map4: Maps must not closely duplicate existing maps, make only trivial changes to them, contain pointless repetition or gameplay unrelated to Celeste, or include inappropriate content such as pornography or graphic violence.
home.discussion: Use {report} to report missing runs or request removal of your maps or videos. Use {feedback} to discuss and vote on difficulty changes and other Gist decisions.
home.qa: See {link} for inclusion criteria and frequently asked questions.

install.lede: Install CNGoldenLink to sync your game status and practice statistics to your CN Gist account.
install.dependency: Required dependencies: Everest and Consistency Tracker (CCT). Neither is included in the sync mod ZIP.
install.prepare: Install the Everest mod loader for Celeste first. The sync mod currently supports Windows and requires Everest 1.6458.0 or newer.
install.cct: Search for Consistency Tracker (CCT) in Olympus and install version 2.10.2 or newer. If already installed, check that it is enabled. CNGoldenLink requires CCT to load.
install.files: Close the game, download {filename} above, and place the ZIP in the Mods folder inside your Celeste installation without extracting it. On Steam, use Manage → Browse local files to find the game folder.
install.update: When updating, move older CNGoldenLink ZIPs out of Mods so that only one version remains, then launch the game with Everest.
install.connect: Open Mod Options, find Remote sync under CNGoldenLink, and enable the connection. Sign in to CN Gist in the browser window that opens, authorize the device, then return to the game.
install.verify: Once the status shows Connected, enter a map and play for a moment. The default sync interval is about 5 seconds. If the status says it is waiting for game data, enter a level first. Check your device authorization and saving status on the account page.
install.overlayIntro: Two built-in themes, APEX (ice blue) and ORBIT (copper and gold), display your current map and practice statistics on stream. No separate Node.js installation is needed.
install.overlayEnable: Enable OBS Overlay in the CNGoldenLink mod settings and select Open Overlay. The default control page is http://localhost:32272/apex; change the path to /orbit for the other theme.
install.overlaySource: Add a Browser source in OBS using one of the URLs below. Set its width to 1920 and height to 1080.
install.overlayGame: Place the game source below the Browser source, at X=24 and Y=24 with a size of 1600×900, to align it with the overlay's transparent area.
install.overlayChallenge: After entering a map, choose your challenge on the control page in your regular browser. Your choice is saved automatically and shared with OBS. If there is only one challenge, it is selected for you. Connect your CN Gist account first to load map, challenge, and tier details.
install.overlayStats: The overlay shows room and checkpoint progress, current and best streaks, the last 20 attempts, estimated golden success rate, overall and session room reach rates and golden deaths, fewest deaths in a complete run without the golden, and total map deaths. Estimates use the CCT route and golden run stats; missing routes or samples are shown as —.
install.overlayLocal: Local statistics refresh about every 500ms. The overlay has its own switch and continues working when uploads are disabled. Challenge and Tier details are unavailable until authorization and map matching are complete; previously retrieved details are cached during temporary service outages.
install.overlayTroubleshooting: If the control page will not open, make sure the game is running and OBS Overlay is enabled. If port 32272 is busy, change OverlayPort in the mod settings file, toggle the overlay off and on, and update both browser and OBS URLs. Request map matching on the CN Gist account page if needed. If local data disconnects, the overlay keeps the last snapshot and marks it as disconnected.
install.missing: If CNGoldenLink settings are missing or dependencies are reported missing, check the Mods folder location and make sure Everest and Consistency Tracker meet the version requirements and are enabled.
install.auth: If browser authorization times out, toggle the connection off and on to retry. If authorization is unavailable, check the saving status on your account page, or clear the local login in the mod and reconnect to authorize again.
